dialogues.opening1: Um, hi.. Oh, am I the first customer..? Uh.. Okay, I can do this I guess.. You’ve got a nice place.
dialogues.opening2: Uhh.. So I’m looking for a dog. A calm one. And um.. Fur makes my nose run, so… Maybe one with less fur? Hard to clean up after too.. It doesn’t have to be super pretty or anything...
dialogues.happy: Aww.. It's adorable. Thank you. Um, how much does it cost?
dialogues.pazarlik1: Oh.. Okay, I'm sorry.. Um, how much more do I have to pay? Alright, here you go.. Bye.

dialogues.opening1: Hello there— goodness, I went through hell and back just trying to walk through this street. People really have no respect for their elders! Gah, if only my knees weren't hurting..
dialogues.opening2: You look very healthy though, how old are you? You remind me so much of my grandchild!
dialogues.opening3: Well, the kid’s birthday's next week. They grow up so fast nowadays, it's already been 11 years! I've been trying to find a good gift and when I passed by your store, I figured a dog would be an amazing choice. One with big eyes, just like my grandchild! Haha!
dialogues.sad1: Oh, not even one? Now that’s no good. Sigh, I need to think of another gift, then. Well, I’ll take a look at the other stores I suppose. Have a great day!
dialogues.happy: Awh, that's an adorable pup! Here, come to granny! Thank you so much sweetheart, here you go.
dialogues.pazarlik1: Oh, it costs more? Huh... Well, a few extra bucks aren't worth my grandkid's happiness now, is it? Haha, here you go.

dialogues.opening1: Hello dear! Such a nice weather, isn't it? Beautiful, like my old dog's eyes.. Even thinking about it brings me to tears..
dialogues.opening2: Oh, of course, I'm sorry... I’d gotten my dog from a petshop just like this. It had the prettiest eyes ever.. big and doe-like. This is going to sound selfish of me, but I'd really appreciate a dog with eyes like its.
dialogues.sad1: Now that's a shame.. still, thank you for your patience love. Seems I've got other stores I need to check...
dialogues.happy: Its eyes are so bright.. so similar.. Thank you honey, this means so much to me. So, how do I repay you? You deserve a generous tip for sure.
dialogues.pazarlik1: Oh? How much more do I need to pay? That's no problem, here you go.

dialogues.opening1: So many flavors.. Uh, hello! Do you have any, um.. What kind of dogs do you have?
dialogues.opening2: I.. I need a pet. To, um... To keep me company, you know.. In the kitchen. Haha...
dialogues.opening3: A big dog is good, very good.. For a meal. O-Oh, I mean... I eat a lot too ― as you can see ― haha. So.. only a dog as big as me should keep me company, right? Haha.. Ha.
dialogues.sad1: Y-You don't? Oh, okay... I can get another one then. No? But.. Why? This is a petshop,  I mean.. I think I should be able to-
dialogues.sad2: ...Whatever, strays are much cheaper anyway.. I hope it won't make me ill, though..
dialogues.happy: Such a big pup, hehe.. even more meaty than I though.. Sorry, I- Um.. Nevermind. We will have a very nice dinner together.
dialogues.pazarlik1: It costs more?? I-I already paid a lot, you know... Can't you go lower? No?? Come on, it's just a dog. It's one-time use anyway... Whatever, i hope the strays won't make me ill, then..

dialogues.opening1: Hi. -chew chew- So this shop opened, what, days ago? Yeah. Let's see what you've got.
dialogues.opening2: I won't bother with your sloppiness so you better make it quick. If I don't like your work, get ready to be voted 'worst shop of the year', got it?
dialogues.opening3: Get me the most beautiful dog you have. I didn't spend years perfecting myself for some furball to notch me down four levels.
dialogues.opening4: If it's gonna be my dog, then it needs to be the best. Like owner, like pet. Ha!
dialogues.opening5: Gosh, is your brain just sitting in your skull!? That's one star down... That animal better not be below %f cuteness, I literally WON'T touch it! Beauty is the ruler for a reason, duh?
dialogues.opening6: Big eyes, petite body, small nose... The basics, you know? Did you understand? Do I need to spell it out? No?
dialogues.opening7: Okay. Now chop chop. Don't you dare keep me waiting for long.
dialogues.sad1: Oh. Of course you couldn't do your one job. That's on me for walking in thinking someone like you could handle true beauty standards. Anyway, enjoy your one-star review. Bye-bye.
dialogues.happy: Ew. What's with her fur? ...I didn't walk the whole street for this. It's going straight to a groomer to fix your mess.
dialogues.happy2: Beauty takes more than your bare minimum, though I wouldn't expect you to know. Duh.. Its face is cute though, I suppose..
dialogues.happy3: Whatever, where do I scan my card? Make it quick or I'm dropping you to two stars.
dialogues.pazarlik1: Nuh uhh~ I don't wanna hear it! -chew chew- Bold of you ask for more. It's an accessory, not Aladdin's magic lamp?
dialogues.pazarlik2: Tch, you know what, just take this. I'm losing braincells just from looking at you..

dialogues.opening1: Hehe... Hehehe.. I love dogs.. So much...
dialogues.opening2: Hello... You've got really cute dogs.. Hehe.. I-I love dogs, you know... More than anything.. There's something special about them..
dialogues.opening3: I like small puppies the most.. They're so cute, all energetic, hehe.. I don't like too much fur though.. Too much hassle..
dialogues.opening4: Can i have one of your dogs, please..?
dialogues.happy: Hehe.. Hehehe.. It's even cuter up closer... We're gonna have so much fun, hehe... Thank you.
dialogues.sad1: H-huh? W-Well... I can take another then. You don't ..want me to have puppy..? B-But why?? I'll take very good care of them, I promise..!
dialogues.pazarlik1: M-More? I already paid so much... What's the lowest you'll go?

dialogues.opening1: Hello! Your shop looks veeerry cool!
dialogues.opening2: I want a dog! I want one as a permanent friend. I have no luck with people, it's reaaaally hard to blend in when all people care about is how you look. I didn't have the best time throughout school just because of my skin, haha..
dialogues.opening3: They say animal's 'ugly' when it's not all cutesy. I disagree! What they think is ugly is the prettiest in my eyes!
dialogues.sad1: Aw shucks.. No chance even with dogs? Even doggies don't wanna be my friend, you say..
dialogues.happy: It's... SO PREEETTTYYYYY, I LOVE ITTTT!! THANK YOU SO SO SOSOSOOO MUCHH!! JUST TAKE MY WALLET PLEASE!!
dialogues.pazarlik1: HERE, TAKE ALL YOU NEED! Oh, leave some though, I need to get it some toys.
